_meta.note: needs is a list of any-of groups that must all be satisfied by our picks; counters are heroes on their side that answer it

combos.name: Silence under a taunt, then burst
combos.text: Stukov silences under the taunted target and the team bursts it with a ranged assassin whose damage minions and heroes cannot block. Fails if they can save the target: Anduin's pull, Medivh or Uther Divine Shield, Tyrael's invulnerability. Cleanses help them but the silence can still get kills.

combos.name: CC tank then one target focus
combos.text: Tyrande is often picked as the follow up to a CC tank to focus down one target with burst ranged damage or a melee assassin. She needs to auto attack safely to bring her heal back.

combos.name: Orphea heroic reset behind big CC
combos.text: Orphea's heroic resets when it hits a hero, which works best behind E.T.C. Mosh Pit or Leoric Entomb.

combos.name: Sonya jumps in behind a CC chain
combos.text: Sonya with Leap is a good partner for CC chain combos (Light bomb and other chains): high burst onto the backline.

combos.name: Whitemane wants CC from the front line
combos.text: Whitemane has little CC, so draft it in the tank and maybe the offlaner. She is weak to tanks that pull or separate her from the team: Stitches, Garrosh, Diablo.

combos.name: Lucio wall riding gets stunned
combos.text: Diablo can stun Lucio on walls while he is wall riding.

combos.name: Lunara and the enemy healer
combos.text: Lunara does great into low sustain healers like Uther because her poison on many people outruns his healing and mana. Healers like Brightwing heal through her steady damage.

combos.name: Murky and quest stackers meet Ragnaros
combos.text: Murky struggles against Ragnaros and others who can kill him for stacks or quests, or kill his W so it does not trigger.

combos.name: Deathwing into a pick comp
combos.text: Pick Deathwing when they have no percent damage hero and they have a pick comp: he cannot be stunned. A strong late pick, often taken in the 4 man as a damage dealer.

combos.name: Hanzo and dive
combos.text: High mobility dive heroes like Zeratul and Genji kill Hanzo easily. Minions and summons also block his abilities.

combos.name: Sgt. Hammer and poke or dive
combos.text: Sgt. Hammer is susceptible to dive and long range poke like Tassadar, Chromie and maybe Li-Ming.

combos.name: Ragnaros on Tomb
combos.text: On Tomb of the Spider Queen, clearing waves with Lava Wave loses the gems.
